entries.value: CHAPTER 4  HAWKSBILL GUZHENG FINGER PICKS
CONCERT HALL  18 JUNE 2025
BEDROOM  EVENING
FICTIONAL MARKETPLACE
MESSAGE THREAD
PACKAGE ARRIVAL
RESEARCH AT THE COMPUTER
PRESERVE EVIDENCE
PREPARE THE REPORT
SEVERAL WEEKS LATER
ELSEWHERE  AROUND THE SAME TIME
MONTHS LATER
ENDING INFORMATION
The last notes of the guzheng solo fade into the concert hall. Applause rises, then dissolves into the soft sound of a phone notification.
Back in the bedroom, the guzheng case lies open beside the desk. Several worn synthetic finger picks rest on a folded cloth.
Reminder: please prepare a reliable new set of guzheng finger picks before next month's examination. Comfort and fit matter more than appearance.
Most search results are labelled synthetic resin, plastic, or imitation tortoiseshell. One heavily advertised listing uses the unfamiliar words 玳瑁古筝义甲 and claims that the material is genuine.
At this point, I am shopping normally. I do not yet know what 玳瑁 means.
Buy the seller-recommended 玳瑁古筝义甲 set.
Buy a clearly labelled synthetic set instead.
The product page presents genuine hawksbill as a premium traditional material recommended for serious students. The player understands it only as the name of a material.
Is this set comfortable, durable, and suitable for my upcoming examination?
It is genuine hawksbill, a traditional material. Customers often choose it for its firm feel. This size should suit you.
The player confirms the purchase without informed suspicion. The scene does not pretend that a wildlife investigation happened before buying.
Several days later, the package arrives. The material name 玳瑁 is printed on the label inside the box.
The picks feel firm and unfamiliar. What does that material name actually mean?
The player selects a synthetic set with a clear material description.
I just got this set! I tried it during practice today and it feels pretty good. The listing calls it 玳瑁. Have you tried this kind?
The player saves the friend's photo and listing screenshot so the unfamiliar material name will not be forgotten.
I have not seen that word before. I want to know what it means.
The computer screen lights the room. In Route A, the product label rests beside the keyboard. In Route B, the friend's screenshot remains open on the phone.
Search result: 玳瑁 is the Chinese name for the hawksbill turtle, Eretmochelys imbricata. Its shell has historically been used to make decorative objects and small accessories.
The player opens official sources for China's national key protected wildlife list and the rules concerning wildlife products, approval, and traceability.

The hawksbill turtle is listed as a Class I national key protected wild animal in China. Special lawful uses of protected wildlife products require approval and traceability under the applicable rules.
Important distinction: the listing is a potential wildlife-trade lead. A photograph and a seller's claim cannot prove that the item is genuine hawksbill.
The task is not to decide that the seller is guilty. The task is to preserve accurate information for people with the authority and expertise to assess it.
New task: preserve what already happened. Do not make another transaction and do not confront the seller.
The player has bought and received the item. The original order, payment, logistics, packaging, labels, listing, and seller conversation can be preserved.
The friend bought a set. The player has only the shared photo, messages, and listing screenshot, and must not invent or access the friend's private order records.
Capture the full listing: title, stated material, price, product images, fictional store account, page address, date, and time. Save the official protected-species source separately.
Classify each record by what it supports. A marketplace page records what appeared online. A seller statement records a claim. Player notes are not expert material identification.
The evidence folder now separates direct records, official sources, personal notes, and statements that still require investigation.
Add the existing order, payment, logistics, packaging, and labels. Stop using the item. Keep it secure, and do not discard, resell, mail, or return it until a verified authority gives instructions.
Attach only the messages and images the friend shared. Do not buy the product to obtain more evidence, and do not claim to possess records that belong to the friend.
A report form opens beside the evidence folder. It does not write an accusation automatically. It asks for only what the records support.
Use the fictional platform's report function and a verified local reporting channel appropriate to the player's region. Reporting details must be localized and checked before release.

I purchased finger picks advertised and recommended as genuine hawksbill. After delivery, I searched the material name out of curiosity and learned that the hawksbill turtle is protected. I stopped using the item. I have not independently verified its material. I am submitting the preserved listing, seller statements, order, payment, logistics, packaging, labels, and official species information for assessment and handling instructions.

A friend sent me a photo and listing for finger picks advertised as genuine hawksbill and said they had bought the set. After searching the unfamiliar material name, I learned that the hawksbill turtle is protected. I did not purchase the product and have not independently verified its material or my friend's purchase. I am submitting only the shared messages, photo, listing screenshot, page information, and official species source for assessment.
Do not write that the seller killed hawksbill turtles or must be arrested. The available records do not prove the material, its source, the supply chain, or a criminal offence.
Report submitted. Save the reference number and keep the evidence unchanged.
Your report has been received. The information may be reviewed or forwarded. This acknowledgement does not confirm the material, establish wrongdoing, or guarantee an enforcement outcome.
The player closes the message. A safe synthetic set rests beside the guzheng strings. The sound is ordinary, clear, and enough.
Audience-only cutaway: in a cramped fictional packing room, new orders join a queue while labelled packets lie beside a keyboard. This is not evidence seen by the player.
Is this the same material as the one in your listing?
Yes, genuine hawksbill. It is in stock. I can send it tomorrow.
He seals another packet and places it on a growing stack. A new order arrives before he finishes. There is no villain monologue and no exaggerated profit counter.
Months later, brief silent shots show investigators comparing transaction records, a specialist examining seized material, and an evidence folder being closed.
Police officers enter the packing room. The seller stops typing. In close-up, an officer closes handcuffs around his wrists; the metal click cuts through the silence.
This depicts a fictional seller being taken into custody, not a conviction and not the automatic result of one report. The investigation developed separately over time.

The hawksbill turtle is a protected marine animal. A product description or visual resemblance cannot establish what a product is made from. Check official sources, preserve accurate records, and use verified reporting channels.
One report may not end an illegal trade. It can still provide a useful lead when it is accurate, complete, and responsibly submitted.
